ai_summary: Advik Capital Limited's statutory auditor, M/s KSMC & Associates, has resigned, citing inadequate professional fees due to the company's stated inability to revise remuneration given its "present financial position" and "incurring losses." This resignation, effective August 2026 to facilitate an orderly transition, presents a significant red flag regarding Advik Capital's financial health and its capacity to fund robust independent audits, potentially impacting investor confidence and governance oversight.
